blocker.summary: The required period-specific SECO monthly first-release artifacts cannot currently be replayed deterministically from an official route in GitHub Actions.
blocker.why_it_matters: SECO seasonal adjustment recalculates history as new observations arrive, so current revised history is not an acceptable substitute for contemporaneous first-release values.

legacy_strict_materializer.finding: The first required month 2018-01 could not be retrieved; historical seco.admin.ch DAM candidates returned HTTP 502 from the runner.

secoalv_archive_probe.finding: Official historical secoalv.admin.ch paths for 2019-02, 2020-01, 2021-01 and 2022-01 all returned HTTP 404.

arbeit_swiss_migrated_route_probe.finding: The same period-specific paths migrated to the current official arbeit.swiss host also returned HTTP 404 for all four probes.

prohibited_shortcuts: Do not use current SNB or SECO revised seasonal-adjusted history as a PIT substitute.
Do not use search-engine caches or third-party mirrors as canonical first-release evidence.
Do not silently splice a different unemployment definition or non-seasonally-adjusted series.
Do not infer historical first-release values from later annual publications.
reopen_conditions: A deterministic official archive route becomes available for every required monthly first-release artifact, or
SECO provides an official revision-vintage dataset that reproduces the as-published monthly seasonally-adjusted rate for the target window.
